description: This file defines the 'Holiday' entity class, including its fields, relationships, and behavior methods such as creation, update, activation, and deletion. It represents holiday data within the organization module of the application, with JPA annotations for persistence and methods to manage holiday state and details.

classes.name: Holiday
classes.description: Entity class representing a holiday with attributes like name, date range, rescheduling details, status, description, and associated offices. Provides methods to create, update, activate, delete, and manage holiday instance data and state.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new Holiday instance from a set of offices and a JsonCommand containing holiday details.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the holiday's attributes based on a JsonCommand; returns a map of changed fields.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the set of associated offices if different from current; returns true if modified.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Changes the holiday's status to active after validation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Marks the holiday as deleted after validation.

methods.name: getReScheduleType
methods.description: Returns the rescheduling type enum corresponding to the stored reschedulingType value.
